warhead.provenance: Explosive weight 7.9 lb = 3.58 kg per OOB (csg-us-ram-navy, A). Lethal radius/damage/case mass are engineering-estimate surrogates for a small fire-and-forget point-defense missile, following the aim_120c.json pattern scaled down.

fuze.provenance: No public fuze timing data; engineering-estimate scaffold consistent with a passive-IR-terminal fire-and-forget missile.

_real_world.role: Fire-and-forget close-in point-defense SAM, Mk 49 GMLS (21 rounds)
_real_world.range_km: ~9 (Blk 1/1A) to ~15 (Blk 2), C-est; Navy publishes no range
_real_world.guidance_real: Passive RF midcourse + IR terminal; fire-and-forget, no illuminator required
_real_world.mount_mapping: ciws (Mk 49 GMLS documented as a CIWS-type mount per authoring standard; can_intercept_missiles: true)

warhead.provenance.note: legacy inline provenance-note scaffold string, superseded by this structured _provenance.parameters block; retained as descriptive metadata, not a runtime scalar

fuze.provenance.note: legacy inline provenance-note scaffold string, superseded by this structured _provenance.parameters block; retained as descriptive metadata, not a runtime scalar

max_flight_time_s.note: engineering estimate derived from the ~9-15 km Tier C-est range band at the used Mach 2-3 speed proxy

flight_model.max_speed.note: Navy states supersonic only (A); Tier C Mach 2-3 used as engineering-estimate midpoint ~850 m/s

flight_model.max_g.note: no public maneuver-load figure; high value consistent with a small fire-and-forget point-defense missile's rapid-response intercept role

flight_model.max_turn_rate.note: no public figure; engineering estimate consistent with max_g for a small, highly agile point-defense missile

guidance.type.note: passive RF midcourse + IR terminal per OOB; modeled here as PassiveIR for the terminal phase since the engine's guidance.type is a single enum. This record has a real ciws mount but guidance.type is not consumed by the CIWS engagement-resolution code path (mount->hit_probability/engagement_range_m only), so this remains descriptive metadata

guidance.active_seek_range.note: no public IR terminal seeker acquisition range; engineering estimate typical of a passive-RF/IR point-defense missile's terminal handoff range

guidance.pn_los_rate_source.note: standard engine guidance-model wiring default, not a sourced weapon characteristic; ciws mount engagement resolution does not consume this field

guidance.target_kinematics_estimator.note: standard engine guidance-model wiring default, same basis as pn_los_rate_source

guidance.capture_guidance_mode.note: disabled: no terminal capture-guidance submode is modeled beyond the passive-RF/IR homing already described

guidance.target_tracker_alpha.note: standard alpha-beta-gamma tracker filter constant, engine convention shared across missile records, not weapon-specific

guidance.target_tracker_beta.note: standard tracker filter constant, same basis as target_tracker_alpha

guidance.target_tracker_gamma.note: standard tracker filter constant, same basis as target_tracker_alpha

guidance.nav_gain.note: proportional-navigation gain scaffold; high value consistent with RAM's point-defense role against maneuvering anti-ship missiles, no sourced guidance-law constant

guidance.apn_target_accel_gain.note: augmented-PN target-acceleration compensation gain scaffold, consistent with intercepting a maneuvering incoming missile; not sourced per-weapon

guidance.autopilot_tau_s.note: autopilot response time-constant scaffold; very fast, consistent with a small high-agility point-defense missile

guidance.max_accel_response_g_per_s.note: autopilot response-rate scaffold, very high consistent with flight_model.max_g

warhead.lethal_radius.note: engineering-estimate surrogate for a small fire-and-forget point-defense missile, following the aim_120c.json pattern scaled down

warhead.damage.note: engineering-estimate surrogate, no public damage-effectiveness figure

warhead.explosive_mass_kg.note: 7.9 lb = 3.58 kg explosive weight is itself the sourced figure; set equal to warhead.mass_kg since the small warhead is assumed near-entirely explosive fill

warhead.case_mass_kg.note: engineering-estimate case mass, no public case/explosive split beyond the sourced explosive weight

warhead.projection_radius_fraction.note: copied from the weapons/air_to_air/aim_120c.json blast-fragmentation projection-geometry template, scaled down for this small warhead

warhead.projection_max_radius_m.note: copied/scaled from the aim_120c.json template pattern for this warhead's lethal_radius

warhead.projection_max_projected_hitboxe.note: copied from the aim_120c.json template pattern, reduced for a small point-defense warhead

fuze.type.note: no public fuze timing data; proximity is the matching real engine-recognized default fuze type for a passive-IR-terminal fire-and-forget missile, per the loader's fuze.type vocabulary

fuze.trigger_radius_m.note: no public fuze timing data; engineering-estimate scaffold value matching warhead.lethal_radius

fuze.delay_s.note: no public fuze timing data; engineering-estimate scaffold value

fuze.reliability.note: no public reliability figure; engineering-estimate scaffold value

modeling_notes: Range conflicts across Tier C sources (9-15 km vs seaforces '10 nmi' for Block 2B); not directly encoded as a JSON field. Placed as a ciws-type mount per the authoring standard's mapping rule for RAM.
